about.title: About L-LEX
about.body: L-LEX is a free trilingual legal research platform for Iraqi and Kurdistan Region legislation. It helps citizens, students, journalists, and professionals find exact articles by number, keyword, or penalty in Kurdish Sorani, Arabic, and English — without accounts, tracking, or paywalls.
about.missionBody: Make legislation understandable and reachable: preserve the Sorani source text as the legal reference, expose translation status honestly, and keep the interface fast, accessible, and private by design.
about.scopeBody: Full-text and article-number search across indexed laws, per-article conditions and penalties, law overviews, favorites stored only in your browser, and a global visitor counter with no personal profiles.
about.method: Kurdish Sorani is the source-of-truth language for the core statutes. English and Arabic entries are machine-generated or bundle-supplied and are always labeled with a visible per-article status until human legal review.
about.creatorBody: L-LEX was created and is maintained by Las Khoshnaw, an independent developer building civic legal-tech tools for Iraqi and Kurdistan Region audiences. The project focuses on clear trilingual access to legislation, careful data handling, and transparent machine-translation labeling.
about.legalNotice: L-LEX is an unofficial reference tool, not legal advice. Always verify important matters against the official gazette or parliament text.
landing.subline: Search the Iraqi Penal Code and the Kurdistan Internal Security Forces Law — by article number, keyword, or penalty type.
landing.featureTrilingualBody: Full interface and content in Kurdish Sorani, Arabic, and English — with correct right-to-left and left-to-right rendering.
landing.featureSearchBody: Find any article in under a second — by number in Western or Eastern-Arabic digits (251 or ٢٥١), keyword, or penalty type.
landing.featurePrivacyBody: No accounts and no analytics — favorites and preferences live only in your browser.
